create_archimate_diagram.name: create_archimate_diagram
create_archimate_diagram.description:
Generate complete ArchiMate diagrams from structured input with comprehensive enterprise architecture modeling support.

Supports all 7 ArchiMate 3.2 layers with 55+ element types and 12 relationship types.
Features automatic language detection (Slovak/English) and intelligent layout optimization.
Generates PNG/SVG files with live HTTP server URLs for instant viewing.

Outputs saved to exports/YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS/ directory:
- diagram.puml: Validated PlantUML code
- diagram.png: Generated PNG image  
- diagram.svg: Generated SVG image
- architecture.md: Extended textual representation
- generation.log: Detailed generation log
- metadata.json: Diagram statistics and metadata

ElementInput.description:
ArchiMate element with comprehensive validation and capability discovery.

Element types are organized by ArchiMate 3.2 layers:
- Business: Business_Actor, Business_Role, Business_Process, Business_Service, etc.
- Application: Application_Component, Application_Service, Data_Object, etc.
- Technology: Node, Device, System_Software, Technology_Service, etc.  
- Physical: Equipment, Facility, Distribution_Network, Material
- Motivation: Stakeholder, Driver, Goal, Requirement, Principle, etc.
- Strategy: Resource, Capability, Course_of_Action, Value_Stream
- Implementation: Work_Package, Deliverable, Implementation_Event, Plateau, Gap

RelationshipInput.description:
ArchiMate relationship with comprehensive validation and capability discovery.

Supports all 12 ArchiMate 3.2 relationship types:
- Access: Element can access another element
- Aggregation: Whole-part relationship (parts can exist independently)  
- Assignment: Element is assigned to another element
- Association: General relationship between elements
- Composition: Whole-part relationship (parts cannot exist independently)
- Flow: Transfer of information, money, goods, etc.
- Influence: Element influences another element  
- Realization: Element realizes or implements another element
- Serving: Element serves another element
- Specialization: Is-a relationship, inheritance
- Triggering: Element triggers another element

analyze_current_architecture.name: analyze_current_architecture
analyze_current_architecture.description:
Analyze the current in-memory architecture model and generate insights.

Returns comprehensive analysis including:
- Element and relationship statistics by layer
- Architecture completeness assessment  
- Layer distribution analysis
- Model health indicators
- Element type breakdown
- Relationship type usage

Useful for understanding model complexity and identifying areas for improvement.

test_element_normalization.name: test_element_normalization
test_element_normalization.description:
Test element type normalization across all ArchiMate layers.

Validates the input normalization system that handles:
- Case-insensitive element types (e.g., "function" → "Business_Function")
- Common naming variations and abbreviations
- Layer-specific element prefixes
- Relationship type normalization

Returns comprehensive test results showing normalization rules and examples.

analyze_recent_errors.name: analyze_recent_errors
analyze_recent_errors.description:
Analyze recent diagram generation errors with actionable troubleshooting guidance.

Features:
- Real-time error detection from validation logs
- Pattern recognition and error categorization
- Contextual troubleshooting recommendations
- Time window analysis (configurable 1-60 minutes)

Error categories:
- Empty Model: No elements defined
- Orphaned Relationships: References to non-existent elements
- Validation Errors: ArchiMate compliance issues
- System Errors: PlantUML generation failures

minutes.description: Time window in minutes to analyze errors (default: 10)
